messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Degraded generation quality detected for tenant \"zenith-enterprises\" on dedicated pool `dedicated-zen-07`. Metric: post-deploy eval BLEU-like quality -22% vs baseline after rollout of quantization profile `qp-4bit-2026-03`. Rollout started 2918374510.
rachel_oncall: Taking this. Noted severity P2 (customer quality). Can someone confirm isolation + customer impact details?
deepak_ml: Quick check: rollout targeted pool `dedicated-zen-07` only. That pool is dedicated to zenith-enterprises. We see spike in low-confidence tokens and higher repetition on their prompts. Gate eval job flagged delta -0.22 at 10:15 UTC.
deepak_ml: Paste from gating job:
```
[2026-03-15T10:15:21Z] rollout-service INFO apply qp-4bit-2026-03 -> dedicated-zen-07
[2026-03-15T10:16:03Z] eval-gate ERROR quality_drop tenant=zenith-enterprises delta=-0.22
[2026-03-15T10:16:07Z] serving WARN kv-cache mismatch during kv-restore
```
zoe_eng: Confirmed pool single-tenant. No other customers affected. Logs show a small uptick in model fallback events but no 5xx errors.
tanya_csm: Zen support pinged AE at ~10:20 reporting "answers are getting weird" on two production flows. They're concerned and want ETA.
eric_support: Customer impact: high for those flows; traffic steady but they classify it as "functionally incorrect" rather than outage.
rachel_oncall: Options: 1) Roll back profile to last known-good `qp-8bit-2026-02` (fast). 2) Reroute their traffic to `stable-serving-variant` (safe but could add latency). 3) Patch `qp-4bit-2026-03` with micro-fix and redeploy (longer). My recommendation: rollback profile immediately.
deepak_ml: I agree. Rolling back will restore seq-level behavior; patching could take hours. I'll prepare revert command. Need an exec approval.
zoe_eng: I'll stand by to monitor infra and scale pods if revert causes transient pressure. Also will create temporary audit log to capture sample outputs for RCA.
tanya_csm: Please notify customer ETA ~12 minutes for rollback and validation. I'll send interim update.
deepak_ml: Executing revert now.
```
POST /internal/rollouts/revert HTTP/1.1
Host: control-plane.internal
Authorization: Bearer $ROLL_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"pool":"dedicated-zen-07","from_profile":"qp-4bit-2026-03","to_profile":"qp-8bit-2026-02"}
```
deepak_ml: Revert acknowledged by control plane; job id `rb-2918374670`. Monitoring revert progress.
zoe_eng: Tailing pod logs and metrics: `kubectl -n redwood-serving logs -l pool=dedicated-zen-07 -f --since=30m`. No crash loops.
[~10m later]
deepak_ml: Revert finished at 10:26 UTC, status=success. Post-revert smoke eval running with customer prompt set.
```
rollout-service: revert completed rb-2918374670 -> qp-8bit-2026-02 for pool dedicated-zen-07
```
eric_support: AE updated zenith-enterprises at 10:28: "We've rolled back a configuration change and are validating responses; expect improvement within minutes." Customer acknowledged, wants formal RCA later.
tanya_csm: They asked to keep them in loop; will schedule a follow-up 1:1 tomorrow.
zoe_eng: Observability: quality metrics trending back to baseline in eval harness; production sampling shows improved outputs. No change in request latency or error rates. Leaving high-frequency checks for 45m.
rachel_oncall: Assigning post-incident tasks: - block qp-4bit-2026-03 from further rollouts until investigation complete (owner deepak_ml). - add per-tenant canary gating for quant profiles (owner deepak_ml + zoe_eng). - update runbook to require per-tenant eval set when deploying quantized profiles to dedicated pools (owner zoe_eng).
deepak_ml: Will open an investigation ticket with artifacts (eval diffs, sample prompts, kernel swap logs) and a PR to add stricter gating.
rachel_oncall: Handoff: I'll remain oncall for 15 more minutes, then hand to zoe_eng for post-revert monitoring and formal postmortem.
zoe_eng: Taking ownership for postmortem and fixes. Scheduling follow-up with eng-ml and support tomorrow 09:30.
incident-bot: Incident updated -> severity=P2, owner=zoe_eng, customer-impact=zenith-enterprises (quality regression), sla-impact=none.
rachel_oncall: Closing active page. If any regression reappears ping @rachel_oncall directly. Thanks everyone.
